t: The Pneumatic Wrench is the $(thing)wrench/$ item for $(pncr). You can use it for a variety of tasks, including:$(p)$(li)$(thing)Right-click/$ vanilla and modded blocks to rotate them$(li)$(thing)Sneak+right-click/$ $(pncr) machines to drop them as items, preserving any stored upgrades and air in the machine.
气动扳手是$(#228)气动工艺$()的$(thing)扳手/$物品。你可以用它执行多种任务，包括：$(p)$(li)$(thing)右击/$原版和模组方块可以旋转它们$(li)$(thing)潜行右击/$$(#228)气动工艺$()机器可使其掉落为物品，并保留机器中存储的升级和空气。
